card.name: Start of place and proper names
card.fires_on: A single capital letter or short opening piece that begins a rare place or proper name, such as a town, pass, castle or anatomical term, in encyclopedic or travel text. The rest of the name follows in the next piece.

modes.label: Place names
modes.description: The first letter of a rare town, pass or fortress name, often European or Himalayan.

modes.label: Other proper names
modes.description: The first letter of a name, acronym or Latin term after a word like the.
